# Error classifications

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from src/ancestry_cli/runtime.py; do not edit by hand -->

A failing result is `{"ok": false, "classification": ..., "state": ..., "dispatch_attempted": ...}` plus, for the codes below,
`retryable`, `needs_human`, `hint` and `next_actions`. See [agents.md](agents.md) for how to act on them.

**Fields**

- `state`: what you may assume about the tree. `unchanged` (nothing was sent, or the server clearly refused), `unknown` (a request
  left and the result is not known: verify before doing anything else), `changed` (confirmed).
- `retryable`: safe to re-run the identical command (after `retry_after` seconds when given). Never true when `state` is `unknown`.
- `needs_human`: something only the owner can do (sign in, solve a challenge, edit config).
- `next_actions`: ordered recovery steps. `run` gives the exact argv (ids filled in; `<name>` marks a choice you make), `retry`
  re-runs the same command, `human` says what the owner must do, `edit-args` says what to change in your arguments.
- `problems` (validation errors): `[{field, issue: missing|invalid|not-allowed|unknown-value, expected?, valid_values?, did_you_mean?}]`.
- `journal_id`: the journal entry for a request that was sent. `progress`: `{done, failed_at}` for multi-request operations.
- `warnings`: `[{code, message}]` for non-fatal issues; may appear on successful results.
- `details`: safe context (`status`, `server_error_code`, `response_shape`). Never values from your tree.

Exit codes: `0` ok, `1` failed with nothing changed, `2` bad usage, `3` state unknown (stop and verify).

| classification | retryable | needs a human | what to do | next actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `browser-lane-not-running` | no | yes | Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port=9224 and a dedicated --user-data-dir, sign in to ancestry.com, and leave one tab open on www.ancestry.com. | human: Start Chrome with --remote-debugging-port={port}, sign in to ancestry.com and keep one tab open on www.ancestry.com.<br>run: `ancestry doctor` *(after-human)* |
| `browser-lane-ambiguous` | no | yes | Close the extra tabs (exactly one page may be open), or run `ancestry lane reset`. | human: Close all tabs but one.<br>run: `ancestry lane reset` *(after-human)* |
| `browser-lane-site-required` | no | no | The tab is not on www.ancestry.com. Run `ancestry lane reset`. | run: `ancestry lane reset`<br>retry: retry the same command |
| `browser-lane-target-invalid` | no | yes | Chrome returned an unexpected tab id. Close and reopen the tab. | human: Close and reopen the ancestry.com tab.<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `browser-lane-target-changed` | yes | no | The tab changed during the call. Retry. | retry: retry the same command |
| `lane-page-unusable` | yes | no | The tab cannot run requests (often an error page). Run `ancestry lane reset`, then retry. | run: `ancestry lane reset`<br>retry: retry the same command *(after-reset)* |
| `session-expired` | no | yes | Sign in to ancestry.com again in the Chrome window, then retry. | human: Sign in to ancestry.com again in the Chrome window.<br>run: `ancestry doctor` *(after-human)* |
| `bot-challenge` | no | yes | Ancestry showed a bot challenge. Solve it in the Chrome window; calls are blocked for 15 minutes. | human: Solve the challenge in the Chrome window.<br>run: `ancestry doctor` *(after-retry_after)* |
| `bot-challenge-block` | yes | no | Calls are paused after a bot challenge. Wait `retry_after` seconds, then retry. | retry: retry the same command *(after-retry_after)* |
| `rate-limited` | yes | no | Ancestry is rate limiting. Wait `retry_after` seconds and retry. | retry: retry the same command *(after-retry_after)* |
| `preflight-failed` | yes | no | The page check returned an unexpected response. Retry; if it repeats run `ancestry doctor`. | retry: retry the same command<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `native-operation-failed` | yes | no | An unexpected error stopped the command before anything was sent. Retry once; if it repeats, run `ancestry doctor`. | retry: retry the same command<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `anchor-ids-unresolved` | yes | no | Could not read the anchor person's ids from the page. Retry; if it repeats, run `ancestry doctor`. | retry: retry the same command<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `eval-version-unresolved` | yes | no | The hints page did not expose the web app version. Retry; if it repeats the site layout may have changed. | retry: retry the same command<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `snapshot-failed` | yes | no | Could not save the before-snapshot, so nothing was sent. Retry. | retry: retry the same command |
| `person-not-in-tree` | no | no | That person id does not exist in that tree (or was deleted). Check --tree and --person. | run: `ancestry find --tree {tree_id} --surname <surname>`<br>edit-args: Use a person id from `find` or `person`. |
| `no-edit-rights` | no | yes | The signed-in account cannot edit this tree. | human: Sign in as an account that can edit this tree, or choose another tree.<br>run: `ancestry trees` |
| `wrong-account` | no | yes | The signed-in account differs from the pinned account_id. Sign in as the right account, or re-pin with `ancestry whoami --pin`. | human: Sign in as the pinned account, or re-pin with `ancestry whoami --pin`.<br>run: `ancestry whoami` |
| `actor-unresolved` | no | yes | Could not read the account id from the person page. Run `ancestry doctor`. | run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `account-unresolved` | no | yes | Could not tell the account from your owned trees. Run `ancestry doctor`. | run: `ancestry doctor` |
| `unknown-tree` | no | no | Unknown tree id or alias. | run: `ancestry trees` |
| `tree-not-writable` | no | yes | This tree is not in write_trees for the active profile. | human: If this tree should be writable, add its id to write_trees in ~/.ancestry-cli/config.json.<br>run: `ancestry trees` |
| `confirm-tree-required` | no | no | Repeat the tree id with --confirm-tree (typo guard for non-sandbox trees). | edit-args: Add --confirm-tree {tree_id}. |
| `duplicate-write` | no | no | An identical write was recorded in the last 24 hours. Pass --force only if you really mean to repeat it. | run: `ancestry journal verify --id {journal_id}`<br>edit-args: Add --force only if verify shows the earlier write did not happen. |
| `unknown-outcome` | no | no | A request was sent but its result is unknown. Do not retry: run `ancestry journal verify --id <journal_id>`, then `ancestry journal resolve --id <journal_id> --as ok|failed`. | run: `ancestry journal verify --id {journal_id}`<br>run: `ancestry journal resolve --id {journal_id} --as <ok|failed>` *(after-verify)* |
| `merge-job-failed` | no | no | The hint upload started but did not finish, so the outcome is unknown. Do not retry: run `ancestry journal verify --id <journal_id>`. | run: `ancestry journal verify --id {journal_id}`<br>run: `ancestry journal resolve --id {journal_id} --as <ok|failed>` *(after-verify)* |
| `confirmation-failed` | no | no | The hint upload went through but was not confirmed, so the outcome is unknown. Do not retry: run `ancestry journal verify --id <journal_id>`. | run: `ancestry journal verify --id {journal_id}`<br>run: `ancestry journal resolve --id {journal_id} --as <ok|failed>` *(after-verify)* |
| `privacy-incident` | no | no | A dependency printed output that was discarded. The write may have happened: run `ancestry journal verify --id <journal_id>`. | run: `ancestry journal verify --id {journal_id}`<br>run: `ancestry journal resolve --id {journal_id} --as <ok|failed>` *(after-verify)* |
| `send-failed` | no | no | The server rejected the write; nothing changed. Check the fields (`ancestry ops <op>`) and the ids. | run: `ancestry ops {op}`<br>edit-args: Fix the fields or ids; the server rejected this write. |
| `usage-error` | no | no | Check `ancestry <command> --help`. | edit-args: Fix the arguments listed in `problems`. |
| `configuration-error` | no | no | A tree id, option or combination is invalid for this command. Check `ancestry <command> --help`. | edit-args: Check the tree id and the options. |
| `invalid-write-request` | no | no | A required field is missing or not allowed for this operation. See `problems` and `ancestry ops <op>`. | run: `ancestry ops {op}`<br>edit-args: Fix the fields listed in `problems`. |
| `fact-not-found` | no | no | That assertion id is not on this person. Use `ancestry person` to list fact ids. | run: `ancestry person --tree {tree_id} --person {person_id}` |
| `invalid-media-file` | no | no | Use an absolute path to a png, jpg, gif or webp file up to 25 MB. | edit-args: Use an absolute path to a png, jpg, gif or webp file up to 25 MB. |
| `unknown-tag` | no | no | Unknown tag name. Use a listed tag name or its numeric id. | edit-args: Use a tag name from `did_you_mean`, or a numeric tag id. |
| `live-not-admitted` | no | no | That operation cannot be sent live. | run: `ancestry ops` |
| `hint-id-required` | no | no | Pass --hint-id (see `ancestry hint list`). | run: `ancestry hint list --tree {tree_id} --person {person_id}` |
| `hint-not-found-or-not-a-record` | no | no | That hint is not among the person's new hints, or it has no record. List them with `ancestry hint list`. | run: `ancestry hint list --tree {tree_id} --person {person_id}` |
| `missing-arguments` | no | no | Required options for this read are missing. See `ancestry read --help`. | edit-args: Provide the required options for this read. |
| `missing-path-param` | no | no | This endpoint needs a path value (see `missing`); pass it with --path key=value. | edit-args: Add --path {missing}=<value>. |
| `side-effecting-read` | no | no | That endpoint starts server-side work and is not offered as a read. | run: `ancestry read list` |
| `specify-id-or-all` | no | no | Pass --id N to undo one entry, or --all (entries on non-sandbox trees need --id). | run: `ancestry journal list` |
| `tree-and-person-required` | no | no | This endpoint needs both --tree and --person. | edit-args: Add --tree and --person. |
| `unknown-endpoint` | no | no | No such read endpoint. List them with `ancestry read list`. | run: `ancestry read list` |
| `read-failed` | no | no | The server returned an error for this read (see `status`). Nothing was changed. | edit-args: Check the ids and parameters; see `status`.<br>run: `ancestry doctor` |
